name: slider
description: Slider: tint, sizing; caller-owned value, labels.
docs: Use the native `Slider` with `.tint(_:)` and `.controlSize(_:)` where the design needs them. The registry adds no wrapper: those modifiers only forward environment values the control already respects.
accessibility: Retains Slider semantics, gestures; caller-owned value, bounds, step, callbacks.
Needs meaningful label; supports min/max labels; inherits size, enabled, direction (overridable).
